headline: Angola-Japan: Tokyo Plans USD 262.6 Million, Including 260 Million for Power Line Between Lubango and Namibia
summary: Financial Afrik reports Tokyo plans $262.6 million, including $260 million for a power line between Lubango and Namibia. The report is based on a members-only article.
why: Japanese official development finance often funds infrastructure such as power transmission, which can support regional grid integration and contractor activity.
original_headline: Angola-Japon : Tokyo prévoit 262,6 millions USD, dont 260 millions pour une ligne électrique entre Lubango et la Namibie
